segments.he: מַתְנִי' כׇּל הַיָּד הַמַּרְבָּה לִבְדּוֹק בַּנָּשִׁים — מְשׁוּבַּחַת, וּבָאֲנָשִׁים — תִּקָּצֵץ.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» With regard to «any hand that is diligent to examine» bodily emissions to ascertain ritual impurity, «among women» such a hand «is praiseworthy. But among men» such a hand «should be severed,» as this action is apt to lead to a seminal emission for naught.

moves.summary: frequent examination: praiseworthy for women, severed for men

positions.claim: frequent examination is praiseworthy for women and forbidden for men

unresolved.issue: 12b.11 is the chapter-end formula (הדרן); no en or biurHe; steinsaltzHe missing for 13a.1
